PonyLlamaCppModelLoader.description: Load a local GGUF model, multimodal projection, and chat handler.

mmproj.name: Multimodal Projection
mmproj.tooltip: Choose the matching vision/audio projection. Use None for text-only models.

chat_handler.name: Chat Handler
chat_handler.tooltip: Choose a handler that matches the model. Gemma4-Thinking is only for models that support it.

n_ctx.name: Context Length
n_ctx.tooltip: Context window size. Larger values allow more text and images but use more memory.

vram_limit.name: VRAM Limit (GB)
vram_limit.tooltip: Maximum GPU memory in GB. -1 places as many layers on the GPU as possible.

image_min_tokens.name: Minimum Image Tokens
image_min_tokens.tooltip: Minimum visual tokens per image. 0 lets llama.cpp choose automatically.

image_max_tokens.name: Maximum Image Tokens
image_max_tokens.tooltip: Maximum visual tokens per image. 0 is automatic; higher values preserve more detail but run slower.

load_mtp.name: Load MTP
load_mtp.tooltip: Enable built-in MTP speculative decoding. The selected GGUF must contain MTP layers.

kv_cache_mode.name: KV Cache Combination
kv_cache_mode.tooltip: Set K/V cache precision together. F16 has the best quality; Q8/Q4 use less VRAM.

cpu_moe.name: MoE Experts on CPU
cpu_moe.tooltip: Qwen3.6 MoE only. Moves all expert weights to CPU to save VRAM, usually slower.

n_cpu_moe.name: First N MoE Layers on CPU
n_cpu_moe.tooltip: Qwen3.6 MoE only. Moves the first N expert layers to CPU; ignored when all experts use CPU.

0.name: Llama Model
0.tooltip: Model configuration passed to instruction nodes.

PonyLlamaCppInstruct.description: Run text, multi-image, video-frame, and supported audio instructions with a local llama.cpp model.

llama_model.name: Llama Model
llama_model.tooltip: Connect the Llama.cpp Model Loader output.

custom_prompt.name: User Prompt
custom_prompt.tooltip: Describe the task for the current image, images, video frames, or text.

system_prompt.name: System Prompt
system_prompt.tooltip: Optional system instructions. Leave empty to use the built-in general assistant prompt.

inference_mode.name: Inference Mode
inference_mode.tooltip: Choose how connected images are processed.

max_frames.name: Maximum Frames
max_frames.tooltip: Video mode only: maximum frames sampled evenly from each IMAGE batch.

max_megapixels.name: Max Image Megapixels
max_megapixels.tooltip: Maximum pixels per image before inference. 0.5 MP means 524,288 pixels.

seed.name: Seed
seed.tooltip: Fixed seed makes repeated runs more reproducible.

unload_mode.name: Model Unload Mode
unload_mode.tooltip: Choose when the GGUF model is released. Keeping it loaded is faster.

parameters.name: Inference Parameters
parameters.tooltip: Connect Llama.cpp Parameters to control sampling and generation length.

image_bundle.name: Image Bundle
image_bundle.tooltip: Connect the Image Bundle output from the dynamic image input companion.

queue_handler.name: Queue Control
queue_handler.tooltip: Controls execution order only. It does not carry image or video content.

skill.name: Skill / System Prompt
skill.tooltip: A non-empty Skill or system prompt overrides the system prompt above.

audio.name: Audio
audio.tooltip: Optional ComfyUI AUDIO input. Supported by Gemma4, Gemma4-Thinking, and Qwen3-ASR; other handlers report a clear error.

1.name: Output List
1.tooltip: One result per image group when applicable.

PonyLlamaCppParameters.description: Configure sampling, temperature, penalties, and Mirostat options.

max_tokens.name: Max Tokens
max_tokens.tooltip: Maximum total generated tokens, including thought and final answer.

top_k.name: Top K
top_k.tooltip: Limit sampling to the K most likely tokens. 0 disables the limit.

top_p.name: Top P
top_p.tooltip: Nucleus sampling probability. Lower values are more conservative.

min_p.name: Min P
min_p.tooltip: Discard tokens below this relative probability.

temperature.name: Temperature
temperature.tooltip: Higher values are more random; lower values are more stable.

repeat_penalty.name: Repeat Penalty
repeat_penalty.tooltip: Penalize repeated tokens. Slightly above 1.0 reduces loops.

frequency_penalty.name: Frequency Penalty
frequency_penalty.tooltip: Discourage tokens that already appear often.

present_penalty.name: Presence Penalty
present_penalty.tooltip: Discourage any token that already appears in the result.

mirostat_mode.name: Mirostat Mode
mirostat_mode.tooltip: Mirostat sampling mode: 0 off, 1 or 2 enabled.

mirostat_tau.name: Mirostat Tau
mirostat_tau.tooltip: Mirostat target entropy. Lower values are more focused.

gemma4_reasoning_budget.name: Gemma4 Thinking Budget Tokens
gemma4_reasoning_budget.tooltip: Gemma4 only. -1 is unlimited, 0 skips thought, and positive values limit thought tokens.

PonyParseJson.description: Read a value from JSON text by path and output common ComfyUI types.

input.name: JSON Text
input.tooltip: JSON text or a value that already contains a parsed object.

key.name: Key Path
key.tooltip: Optional dot path, for example data.items.0.name.

default.name: Default Value
default.tooltip: Value returned when the key is missing or invalid.

PonyJsonToBBox.description: Convert JSON bounding boxes into ComfyUI BBOX data and an annotated image.

mode.name: Parse Mode
mode.tooltip: Choose the coordinate interpretation used by the source model.

label.name: Label Source
label.tooltip: Keep only boxes with this label. Empty keeps all boxes.

image.name: Image
image.tooltip: Optional image used to scale or clamp coordinates.

1.name: Image List
1.tooltip: Optional preview images with boxes drawn.

PonyBBoxToSEGS.description: Convert bounding boxes into ComfyUI SEGS.

bboxes.name: Bounding Boxes
bboxes.tooltip: Bounding boxes from JSON to BBox or Select BBox.

image.name: Image
image.tooltip: Image used as the coordinate reference.

dilation.name: Dilation
dilation.tooltip: Expand each box by this many pixels.

feather.name: Feather
feather.tooltip: Blur the region edge by this many pixels.

PonyBBoxToMask.description: Convert bounding boxes into a MASK with dilation and feather controls.

bboxes.name: Bounding Boxes
bboxes.tooltip: Bounding boxes to convert into a mask.

image.name: Image
image.tooltip: Image that defines the output mask size.

dilation.name: Dilation
dilation.tooltip: Expand each box by this many pixels.

feather.name: Feather
feather.tooltip: Blur the mask edge by this many pixels.

PonySelectBBox.description: Select one bounding box by image index and box index.

bbox_index.name: Box Index
bbox_index.tooltip: Zero-based box index inside the selected image.

PonyPromptEnhancerPreset.description: Read 19 ordered presets bundled inside this plugin.

preset.name: Prompt Preset
preset.tooltip: Choose a built-in system prompt preset.

PonyLlamaCppTextEncoder.description: Encode text with a local Llama.cpp model and output CONDITIONING.

type.name: Encoding Type
type.tooltip: Choose the hidden-state preset expected by the target generation model.

force_offload.name: Unload After Run
force_offload.tooltip: Unload the local model after encoding.

0.name: Conditioning
0.tooltip: Conditioning produced by the local model.

PonyApiLlmLoader.description: Configure an OpenAI-compatible API and refresh available models.

模型名称.name: Model Name
模型名称.tooltip: Model identifier used by the API.

接口地址.name: Base URL
接口地址.tooltip: OpenAI-compatible base URL or full endpoint.

接口密钥.name: API Key
接口密钥.tooltip: API key. It is stored in this node when the workflow is saved.

PonyApiLlmChain.description: Run text, multi-image, web-search, and grouped requests through an OpenAI-compatible API.

模型.name: API Model
模型.tooltip: Connect the API LLM Loader output.

系统提示词.name: System Prompt
系统提示词.tooltip: Behavior and output instructions for the API model.

推理模式.name: Inference Mode
推理模式.tooltip: Merge all images into one request, or process each image group separately.

长度参数类型.name: Token-Limit Parameter
长度参数类型.tooltip: API field used to send the output length limit.

发送温度参数.name: Send Temperature
发送温度参数.tooltip: Disable this for models that reject the temperature field.

图片像素上限.name: Image Megapixel Limit
图片像素上限.tooltip: Maximum pixels per image before upload. 1 MP = 1,048,576 pixels.

流式响应.name: Streaming Response
流式响应.tooltip: Read the response as a stream. Final text is still returned together.

联网搜索.name: Web Search
联网搜索.tooltip: Request provider-side web search when supported.

搜索关键词.name: Search Query
搜索关键词.tooltip: Optional query used for web search.

image_bundle.name: Image Bundle
image_bundle.tooltip: Images sent to the API model.

额外参数.name: Extra API Parameters
额外参数.tooltip: Optional JSON object merged into the API request.

skill.name: Skill / System Prompt
skill.tooltip: A non-empty Skill overrides the system prompt.

3.name: Reasoning
3.tooltip: Reasoning content when provided by the API.

PonyApiImageEditor.description: Generate or edit images through supported remote APIs and reference images.

接口协议.name: API Protocol
接口协议.tooltip: Select the request/response format required by the image provider.

接口地址.name: Base URL
接口地址.tooltip: Base URL or full endpoint for the image API.

接口密钥.name: API Key
接口密钥.tooltip: API key. It is saved inside the workflow.

提示词.name: Prompt
提示词.tooltip: Describe the image to generate or the edit to perform.

请求次数.name: Request Count
请求次数.tooltip: How many API requests to send.

输出宽度.name: Output Width
输出宽度.tooltip: Requested width. 0 lets the provider choose.

输出高度.name: Output Height
输出高度.tooltip: Requested height. 0 lets the provider choose.

限制输出宽高比.name: Limit Output Aspect Ratio
限制输出宽高比.tooltip: Crop or validate the result against the requested ratio.

参考图百万像素上限.name: Reference Megapixel Limit
参考图百万像素上限.tooltip: Maximum pixels per reference image. 1 MP = 1,048,576 pixels; 0 disables the limit.

分块传输.name: Chunked Transfer
分块传输.tooltip: Enable chunked HTTP transfer when uploading images.

绕过代理.name: Bypass Proxy
绕过代理.tooltip: Connect directly without the configured system proxy.

失败后继续.name: Continue After Failure
失败后继续.tooltip: Continue returning successful images when one request fails.

image_bundle.name: Image Bundle
image_bundle.tooltip: Reference images used for image editing.

自定义端点.name: Custom Endpoint
自定义端点.tooltip: Optional endpoint path appended to the base URL.

PonyMultiImageResize.description: Configure image resizing. The companion handles images, masks, and bundle; this controller outputs padding mask, dimensions, report, and preview.

resize_mode.name: Resize Mode
resize_mode.tooltip: Choose how image sizes are calculated.

megapixels.name: Megapixel Limit
megapixels.tooltip: Target pixel area uses binary megapixels: 1 MP = 1024 × 1024 = 1,048,576 pixels. A value of 1.0 allows 1,048,576 pixels.

area_multiplier.name: Other-Image Area Multiplier
area_multiplier.tooltip: Area multiplier applied to images after the first one.

edge_length.name: Resize Edge To
edge_length.tooltip: Target length of the selected edge.

crop_mode.name: Crop Mode
crop_mode.tooltip: Stretch, crop, or pad when aspect ratios differ.

resize_method.name: Resize Method
resize_method.tooltip: Which edge is fitted, or use explicit width and height.

interpolation.name: Interpolation
interpolation.tooltip: Resampling filter. Lanczos keeps more detail.

divisor.name: Divisor
divisor.tooltip: Round final width and height to a multiple of this value.

PonyMultiImageResizeIO.description: Provide up to eight image and mask inputs with dynamic resized-image, mask, and bundle outputs.

resize_config.name: Resize Parameters (auto)
resize_config.tooltip: Internal synchronized settings. No manual input is required.

PonyImageInputBundle.description: Collect up to ten dynamic images into one stable bundle for local Instruct, API LLM, and API image nodes.
